NINJA_SLAYER_RELIC_BLANKET_RELIC.title: Mental Blanket
NINJA_SLAYER_RELIC_BLANKET_RELIC.descrip: At the start of your turn, gain {NarakuLife:diff()} [gold]Naraku Life[/gold].
NINJA_SLAYER_RELIC_BLANKET_RELIC.flavor: With his body taken from him, Fujikido can only relive the same nightmare.
NINJA_SLAYER_RELIC_PORTABLE_IRC_TERMINAL: At the start of your turn, gain 1 [gold]Shuriken[/gold].
Saburo keeps no customer ledger. Every order exists only in his head.
NINJA_SLAYER_RELIC_MAGURO_SUSHI_RELIC.de: Upon pickup, heal to full HP.
NINJA_SLAYER_RELIC_MAGURO_SUSHI_RELIC.fl: No soy sauce, but beggars cannot be choosers.
NINJA_SLAYER_RELIC_IRC_TERMINAL_RELIC.de: At the start of your turn, gain 1 Energy and add 1 Busy Line to your hand.
NINJA_SLAYER_RELIC_IRC_TERMINAL_RELIC.fl: A voice can give away a position. Every keystroke is a step along a tightrope.
NINJA_SLAYER_RELIC_MOTHER_UNIX_RELIC.des: At the start of your turn, [gold]Scry[/gold] {Cards:diff()}.
NINJA_SLAYER_RELIC_MOTHER_UNIX_RELIC.fla: She had not fainted, of course. Full-speed typing cancelled the self-destruct command.
NINJA_SLAYER_RELIC_REPORTER_PASS_RELIC.d: In events, you may choose to Report: Upgrade 3 random cards, then end the event.
NINJA_SLAYER_RELIC_REPORTER_PASS_RELIC.f: As a journalist, I swear I cannot turn a blind eye.
NINJA_SLAYER_RELIC_REPORTER_PASS_RELIC.r: This recording may never be broadcast. But the truth has been preserved.
NINJA_SLAYER_RELIC_HACKER_MOTOKO_RELIC.d: Whenever you apply a [gold]Debuff[/gold] to an enemy with a card, increase its amount by {DebuffBonus:diff()}.
NINJA_SLAYER_RELIC_HACKER_MOTOKO_RELIC.f: The world becomes a wireframe. A green compass locks onto the faint radio signal.
NINJA_SLAYER_RELIC_ELECTRIC_BOOBY_TRAP_R: At the start of the first turn of each combat, lose 2 Energy and Stun ALL enemies.
An electromagnetic pulse strikes. The motorcycle loses balance and explodes.
NINJA_SLAYER_RELIC_NANCY_ZAZEN_DRINK_REL: Upon pickup, add 1 Zazen Drink and 2 Poor Sleep to your deck.
Five bottles hang at her waist like a bandolier. The final job begins.
NINJA_SLAYER_RELIC_CHADO_BREATHING_RELIC:
At the start of each combat, [gold]Chado Breathing[/gold] 2.
[gold]Retain[/gold] your [gold]Chado[/gold] for the next 1 turn.
Chado. Furin Kazan. Then Chado again.
NINJA_SLAYER_RELIC_DEEP_CHADO_BREATHING_: At the start of each combat, add 2 [gold]Chado[/gold] to your [gold]Hand[/gold]. [gold]Chado Breathing[/gold] 2. [gold]Retain[/gold] your [gold]Chado[/gold] for the next turn.
The numbness recedes. Fingers, palms, and arms regain their freedom in turn.
NINJA_SLAYER_RELIC_NARAKU_WITHIN_RELIC.d: At the start of each combat, enter [gold]Fully Released Naraku Form[/gold]. At the start of your turn, add a [gold]Black Flame[/gold] to your [gold]Hand[/gold].
NINJA_SLAYER_RELIC_NARAKU_WITHIN_RELIC.f: The furnace of hatred never went cold. In the depths of his neurons, the old man opens his eyes.
NINJA_SLAYER_RELIC_YAMOTO_KOKI_CUTE_RELI: For the next [blue]{Combats}[/blue] combats, Yamoto Koki will fight beside you.
NINJA_SLAYER_RELIC_YUKANO_COMPANION_RELI: For the next [blue]{Combats}[/blue] combats, Yukano will fight beside you.
‘Ninja Slayer-san, I will travel with you for a while.’
NINJA_SLAYER_RELIC_BIO_BAMBOO_RELIC.flav: A length of bamboo left behind by Sawatari.
NINJA_SLAYER_RELIC_BEPPIN_FRAGMENT_RELIC: The first time you lose HP each combat, gain {Karate} [gold]Karate[/gold].
A fragment of the demonic blade Beppin.
